localizedDescriptions.en: Paste Pinduoduo team codes and submit to multiple helper sites in parallel. Codes up to 10 digits are sent as one; longer input is auto-split into 8/9-digit chunks. Returns as soon as any site succeeds. Shows success count as N/3.
localizedDescriptions.zh: 粘贴拼多多组队码，并行提交到多个互助站点。10 位以内视为单个码直发；超过 10 位自动按 8/9 位切分。任一站点成功即立即返回（单码总时限 5 秒），结果用成功数/总数（如 1/3）显示。支持快捷指令文本输入。

description: Submit Pinduoduo team codes (<=10 digits sent as one, longer auto-split) to multiple mirror sites. First success returns immediately.
name: PDD 快捷提交
